title: Woman in Floral Dress & Hat, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo 1947
description: A full-length black and white snapshot of a middle-aged woman elegantly dressed in post-WWII 1940s fashion. She wears a floral patterned tea-length dress with a belted waist, white wrist-length gloves, eyeglasses, and a prominent floral headpiece or hat in her hair. She carries a dark structured handbag while standing on a lawn in front of a large brick building featuring arched windows. The photograph captures mid-century American social attire and everyday style shortly after the conclusion of World War II.
